items.title: Online sale amount validation is incomplete
verification: invalid_sale_does_not_change_stock_or_create_order; line_subtotals_cannot_drift_by_a_cent_or_pollute_sales_totals
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Server totals validate finite amounts, sufficient cash, tax, discounts and normalized line subtotals.

items.title: Online sale accepts unavailable or foreign product references
verification: checkout_cannot_reference_a_missing_or_foreign_product; unavailable_or_changed_product_is_rejected
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Checkout requires an active, current-price product owned by the authenticated store.

items.title: Online checkout silently oversells stock
verification: unavailable_or_changed_product_is_rejected; existing offline-sale regressions
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Online stock reservations check availability atomically. Known offline cash shortages require an explicit warning/attestation; collected offline cash remains reconcilable.

items.title: Online checkout has no retry idempotency
verification: retry_and_concurrent_void_are_exactly_once; online_gateway_retry_reuses_the_durable_payment_intent; gateway_timeout_preserves_intent_and_retry_never_charges_again
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: A durable store/actor checkout key reuses the order and provider intent; uncertain timeouts never repeat a provider request.

items.title: Order storage failure leaves stock deducted
verification: failed_insert_rolls_back_and_retry_can_succeed
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Order, inventory, ledger and customer benefits commit in a Mongo transaction. Storage failures roll back local effects.

items.title: Concurrent void restores stock repeatedly
verification: retry_and_concurrent_void_are_exactly_once; signed_doku_notifications_require_exact_amount_and_handle_cancel_once
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Concurrent voids restore inventory once; provider cancellation/failure also releases stock once.

items.title: Voided orders can be marked paid again
verification: failed_provider_release_and_late_paid_do_not_corrupt_inventory; signed_doku_notifications_require_exact_amount_and_handle_cancel_once
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Terminal orders cannot become paid through manual actions or late callbacks. Late funds require explicit merchant review.

items.title: Purchase order product lines are discarded
verification: receiving_is_itemized_atomic_and_exactly_once; browser: Creating a purchase preserves its selected product and quantity
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: PO lines retain validated product IDs, quantities, costs and received quantities. Legacy missing lines require explicit repair.

items.title: Receiving changes status but does not add inventory
verification: receiving_is_itemized_atomic_and_exactly_once; browser: Merchant creates an itemized PO, receives it and sees the actual stock movement
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Receiving validates the PO and remaining lines, adds stock and a real ledger event atomically, and deduplicates retries.

items.title: Supplier invoice and payable statuses diverge
verification: linked_invoice_payment_and_reopening_are_consistent; browser: A partial supplier payment and final invoice settlement agree on both screens
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Invoice and payable share transactional partial/full/reopened settlement; UI waits for the persisted status.

items.title: Stock adjustments can succeed without changing the selected product
verification: SKU-less adjustment regression; browser: An SKU-less product can be adjusted through its actual product ID
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Adjustments use product IDs, require positive quantities/reasons, and derive the author from authentication.

items.title: Debt endpoints allow overpayment
verification: linked_invoice_payment_and_reopening_are_consistent
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Debt payments validate bounds and derive status; stale cumulative balances cannot overwrite a concurrent payment.

items.title: Stock movement shows invented business transactions
verification: complete_record_pages_and_real_movements_are_store_scoped; product_stock_compare_and_set_and_import_ledger_and_capacity; browser receiving/adjustment/transfer journeys
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Demo movements are removed. Real sales, reversals, product changes, receipts, adjustments and transfers write ledger events. Legacy incompleteness is disclosed.

items.title: Load errors still look like empty or healthy data on eight screens
verification: browser: A failed read on each audited route is visible to the customer
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Required reads distinguish loading, error, empty and success, with retry and stale-request protection.

items.title: Adjustment, transfer and purchase selectors still stop at product 500
verification: browser: Large catalogue selectors (501 products across three workflows and three layouts)
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Adjustment, transfer and PO selectors enumerate the complete catalogue; tables page separately.

items.title: Customer, supplier and unpaid invoice lists silently truncate
verification: complete_record_pages_and_real_movements_are_store_scoped; older_suppliers_and_unpaid_invoices_have_complete_pages (201/106/101 records)
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Cursor APIs expose total counts and complete store-scoped customer, supplier and invoice collections; current clients enumerate them.

items.title: Warehouse stock movement requests a forbidden POS endpoint
verification: complete_record_pages_and_real_movements_are_store_scoped; browser Warehouse role audit
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Inventory movement uses inventory.read instead of requesting the forbidden POS order endpoint.

items.title: Today totals use UTC instead of the store timezone
verification: today_uses_the_store_day_and_chart_matches_same_boundary (WIB/WITA/WIT)
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Today and seven-day chart boundaries use the configured store timezone.

items.title: Historical profit changes when current product cost changes
verification: historical_profit_uses_immutable_cost_and_flags_missing_legacy_cost; browser recorded-profit journey
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: New sales freeze unit cost; historical profit never reads current product cost. Unknown legacy costs produce an explicit incomplete report.

items.title: Saved loyalty earning rules do not award sale points
verification: loyalty_awards_once_and_void_reverses_once; manual_loyalty_correction_requires_authority_and_current_balance; browser earning journey
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Paid sales award customer points exactly once; void/refund reverses once. Redemption is explicitly unavailable. Manual correction requires authority and a current balance.

items.title: Transfers are record-only and lack basic validation
verification: branch_transfers_reserve_receive_and_cancel_exactly_once; browser: Branch shipment and receipt change only the correct branch balances
backend.xml and e2e/results.json in customer-fixes report
items.implementation: Transfers validate owned distinct branches and product IDs; shipping, receiving and cancellation update the correct branch balances once. Legacy record-only transfers are labelled.
